concerns.text: Task T005 (lambda‑calibration script) is placed in Phase 0 but its implementation description explicitly requires the 30 m binary forest map produced later in Task T009. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer dependency; T005 must be scheduled after T009 (and thus after Phase 2).

Task T007 (resampling) depends on the raw 30 m NLCD raster generated by Task T006. The summary table incorrectly marks T006 and T007 as parallel‑runnable, which would allow T007 to run before its required input exists. Enforce T006 → T007 ordering.

Task T010 (calibration run) depends on the calibration file produced by T005, yet its dependency list only mentions T009. After moving T005 after T009, T010 must also be ordered after T005 to ensure the calibration YAML is available.
